comment: R38.6 §27: curated MCP server registry. Curated from ~6000+ public MCPs (Anthropic official + top community picks). To run an MCP, the user needs the required env_keys set (e.g. GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, BRAVE_API_KEY).

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Read/write/list files under a configured root. The workhorse MCP for any coding agent.

servers.name: git
servers.description: git log, diff, show, status, branch, blame via MCP. Essential for any code-review workflow.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Issues, PRs, repos, code search via the GitHub API. Required for any PR-review or repo-management flow.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Fetch and convert web content to markdown. Replaces the old 'WebFetch' tool.

servers.name: time
servers.description: Current time / timezone conversion. Tiny but useful for any time-sensitive task.

servers.name: brave-search
servers.description: Privacy-focused web search via the Brave API. Better than scraping for general queries.

servers.name: sequential-thinking
servers.description: Step-by-step reasoning MCP — useful for complex multi-step planning problems.

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Browser automation: navigate, click, screenshot, fill forms. Top community pick (11.6k stars).

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Fetches up-to-date library docs / code examples directly into context. Top-rated (61k stars).

servers.name: puppeteer
servers.description: Alternative to Playwright. We pick Playwright as the primary browser MCP, so this is here as a fallback. Use it if Playwright fails to install.
